title: Paro Short Break with Taktsang
alt: Paro valley with the monastery high on the cliff
transport: Private vehicle, driver and licensed guide throughout

stops.name: Paro
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet hotel in the valley below Taktsang

activities.name: Paro sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided round of the valley with the National Museum, Rinpung Dzong and the ruins of Drukgyel Dzong.

activities.name: Hike to the Tiger's Nest
activities.description: The climb to Taktsang, the monastery wedged into a cliff nine hundred metres above the Paro valley floor.

program.name: Paro
program.description: Days in the valley below Taktsang, with Rinpung Dzong, the National Museum and the Tiger’s Nest hike.

1: Arrival at Paro International and transfer to your hotel
Check in below the terraced fields of the valley
The National Museum in the old watchtower
Rinpung Dzong and the Drukgyel ruins
2: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
3: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Paro International for your flight home

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Two nights in one valley. If you only have a long weekend, Paro and the Tiger’s Nest is the trip to take.
expert.tip: Fly in on the morning service. The afternoon arrivals into Paro get turned back more often when the valley wind picks up.

summary: 3 days through Paro, with 2 nights, all meals and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the paro sightseeing tour, the hike to the tiger's nest.
included: Included: 2 nights across Paro with all meals; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Paro sightseeing tour; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
